mode.label: Page protection (Content-Security-Policy)
mode.help: Tells the browser what a page may load. Report only (the default) blocks nothing and only reports what would have been stopped; Enforce makes the browser block it; Off sends no policy. Turn on Enforce only after a week with no reports.

extraSources.label: Outside addresses pages may load from
extraSources.help: The shop loads everything from itself. When you turn on an outside service (for example an ad pixel or a chat window), add its https address here under the kind it needs: scripts, styles, images, fonts, connections, frames, media or form posts.

mode.label: Request limits per address
mode.help: Counts how many requests one internet address sends each minute. Observe (the default) only writes a log line when an address goes over; Enforce asks it to try again in a minute; Off counts nothing. Many phones share one mobile-network address, so the limits are generous.

perMinute.label: Requests a minute for one address
perMinute.help: How many requests one address may send a minute: sign-in and codes, checkout and pay links, other shop changes (bag, wishlist), the browser's problem reports, and webhooks from outside services.

maxTracked.label: Addresses counted at once
maxTracked.help: How many addresses each server copy keeps counting at the same time. Only a memory limit; the oldest counts are dropped first.
